2. What the app is

Raro Camera is a video capture app that runs on your phone. You can:

  • record video (as the device and the chosen format allow);
  • use an on-device voice command (“Raro gravar” / “Raro parar”) when the microphone and recognition are allowed;
  • use the local replay buffer (the last 15 or 30 seconds embedded in the clip, when that feature is on);
  • watch clips saved in the app vault;
  • with an active subscription, save the clip permanently and share it through the system sheet.

It is not a social network. There is no feed, no cloud of ours, and no Raro Camera account. We do not translate audio in real time. We do not show third-party ads or put a watermark on the video.

Some product screens (for example lock mode and volume trigger) may not be active in this version. What is not in the app is not promised by these Terms.

3. No account of ours

We do not ask for email, password, or a profile. Purchase identity, when it exists, is the App Store or Google Play account.

To recover a subscription in the same ecosystem (iPhone → another iPhone, or Android → another Android), use Restore purchases in the app. Switching from iPhone to Android (or the other way) does not take the subscription with you: they are different stores, and we have no login to join them.

5. Permissions and camera use

The app asks for camera, microphone, and, on iOS, speech recognition. On Android, background voice listening uses a foreground service with a notification. You may refuse; whatever depends on that permission stops working.

You are responsible for what you record and share. Do not use the app to capture another person’s image or voice without a legal basis. Do not use it for unlawful content.

Vault clips disappear if you uninstall the app. Make a copy (save to the gallery or share) if you want to keep them.

The app, the Raro Camera mark, the code, and the visual elements belong to Vitor Autorino Lopes (Raro Camera). These Terms do not sell the software: they grant a personal, non-transferable, revocable license to use the app on your device.

The content you record is yours, within the law. You grant us only what is strictly needed for the app to save, show, export, or share that file on your device, at your request. We do not receive a license to republish your video.

7. Availability

The app depends on the device, the system (iOS 15+ / Android API 24+), and, for subscription and telemetry, the network and the stores. We do not promise that every lens, 4K, 60 fps, or voice combination works on every phone. What the device does not deliver, the app does not invent.

Third-party services (Firebase, RevenueCat, Apple, Google) may go down. Without a network, recording on the device can still work; subscribing and restoring a purchase cannot.

8. Limitation

To the extent allowed by Brazilian law, the app is provided “as is”. We are not responsible for file loss if you uninstall the app without exporting, for use that breaks the law, or for the destination you choose on the share sheet.

Nothing in this clause removes a non-waivable consumer right under the Brazilian Consumer Defense Code when you are a consumer in Brazil.

We may update these Terms when the product changes. The date at the top and the canonical URL then apply to later use. If the change is material (price, what the subscription unlocks, new data collection), the Policy must be updated too.

We may stop offering the app or a feature. A subscription already paid follows the store’s cancellation and refund rules.
